decision: Do not port specialized phase classes. Keep active template inventory and recipe reports as the execution surface; add future fixture slices for specific missing policies.

git_hooks: project-local hook files are generated by packaged template application
devcontainer: bundle scaffold system spec verifies generated devcontainer paths
modular_gemfiles: RuboCop LTS token projection is covered
license_files: license tokens are projected from config or gemspec licenses
LICENSE.md and README license content are generated from tokenized templates
copyright holders are collected from git blame into license templates

future_fixture_work: environment-file review diagnostics or noninteractive policy gates
explicit global git-hook template install command or profile
devcontainer JSON merge with trailing-comma destination tolerance
shell-script merge policy for devcontainer scripts and git hooks
license-file pruning and LICENSE.txt migration beyond explicit selected template entries
retired: interactive prompt-driven hook installation during template application
